snippet.title: Legion Was Here - Official Launch Trailer | Out Now on Steam!
snippet.description:
Legion Was Here is out now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3492120/Legion_Was_Here/

Created by French comic artist Geoffroy Monde, Legion Was Here is a dark-comedy spy deduction game, solo-developed without generative AI.

Study a messy case file, piece together your target’s appearance, and rebuild their face in an operating-room character creator. Then walk into a room as someone’s husband, brother, or son—and convince the people who know them best.

Every detail matters. Even a chocolate wrapper. And looking the part is only the beginning: one wrong answer can turn your mission into a very unfortunate ending.

Discover bizarre clients, tense conversations, and absurd surprises in a 3–4 hour adventure. Replay missions to perfect your cover, with randomized questions keeping you on your toes.

STEAM LAUNCH BUNDLES
Discover four special bundles pairing Legion Was Here with other mystery and deduction games:

• Legion Was Here + The Roottrees Are Dead
• Legion Was Here + The Incident at Galley House
• Legion Was Here + The Rise of the Golden Idol
• Legion Was Here + Confidential Killings

Explore the bundles through our Steam store page.

#LegionWasHere #IndieGame #SteamLaunch #SpyGame #DeductionGame
